user.title: Ballinora Match Tracker
user.description: Connect the Ballinora Match Tracker service. The access token is stored encrypted in Home Assistant and is only ever sent in the Authorization header. It is never logged or exposed in diagnostics.

data_description.token: Seen only by the tracker; never stored in plain text.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The tracker rejected the previous access token. Enter a fresh one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the tracker URL and/or access token.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS URL (HTTP is only allowed for localhost).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the tracker. Check the URL and your connection.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Immediately re-download the canonical fixture cache from the tracker. Does not trigger upstream score-source checks.
